outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Exactly twelve full-body separately articulated poses FOUR columns THREE rows, same anatomical size, elevated three-quarter tactical camera facing RIGHT, generous gutters and complete tail/paws inside each cell. Row1: idle four paws grounded mouth shut; alert breathing chest expands ears perk tail subtly lifts; running extended suspension front legs reaching RIGHT and hind legs stretched LEFT; gathered suspension forelegs fold BACK beneath chest and hind legs fold FORWARD beneath belly, arched back, all four distinct legs. Row2: landing front paws grounded hindquarters lifted; attack crouched windup head drawn back jaws opening; forward biting lunge head/jaws extended right forepaws braced; defense low wide stance shoulders tucked head turned slightly toward threat ears flattened. Row3: hit recoil shoulders twist head pulled back; dying foreknees buckle chest sinking; falling on SIDE with four slack bent legs; final DEAD hound prone on side eyes closed jaws slack torso fully horizontal harness still on and tail resting, no blood. No duplicated running silhouettes, no extra limbs, no upright rotated corpse. Original gritty painterly raster, consistent harness markings and body size. Plain pale gray background, no checkerboard, floor/shadows, effects, labels, frame borders or scenery. Original legal artwork.
